data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'bakara' which means 'to be blessed' or 'to be happy'. This name is mentioned in the Hadith as the name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Bukrah carries the meaning “Blessed, Happiness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bukrah usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
